title: Sheriff's office: Motorcyclist, passenger suffer life-threatening injuries after three-vehicle crash in Lee County - NewsBreak
text:
By Chiffon Claiborne ,
1 days ago
LEE COUNTY, Ill (WTVO) — Two people suffered life-threatening injuries in a three-vehicle crash Tuesday afternoon, according to the Lee County Sheriff's Office.
The sheriff's office said deputies responded around 2:53 p.m. to the intersection of Lowell Park Road and Timber Creek Road in rural Dixon for reports of a crash.
Investigators said a motorcycle carrying a passenger was traveling south on Lowell Park Road while a Dodge Ram van was traveling North when the two collided at the intersection and struck a third vehicle.
Officials said the motorcycle rider and passenger were airlifted to local hospitals for treatment.
The cause of this collision remains under investigation.
